Welcome to Naked Wardrobe. I’m here to help you find the perfect fit or answer any questions.
Where can I find your full shipping policy?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
You can view our full shipping policy on our website’s Shipping Policy page. If you’d like, I can also help with a specific shipping question like delivery times, international shipping, or address changes.
Do you ship internationally, and who covers customs or duties?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Yes — we ship internationally to most countries via APC Postal Logistics. Shipping costs vary by destination and are calculated at checkout, and delivery typically takes around 25 business days due to customs processing.
For customs, duties, or import fees, I’d recommend checking the details at checkout or contacting our team at info@nakedwardrobe.com for confirmation, since those charges can vary by country.
How long does standard shipping take once an order is placed?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Standard Shipping typically has a 4–7 BUSINESS DAY FULFILLMENT TIME once the order is placed. If you need it sooner, our fastest available option is PRIORITY SHIPPING, which has a 2–3 BUSINESS DAY FULFILLMENT TIME.
What's your return and refund policy?
KAI • AI ASSISTANT
Returns are accepted within 14 DAYS AFTER DELIVERY if the item is in its ORIGINAL CONDITION: unworn/unused, tags attached, original packaging, and with proof of purchase. A $9.99 RESTOCKING FEE is deducted from each refund, and SALE/MARKDOWN ITEMS, BODYSUITS, INTIMATES, JEWELRY, GIFT CARDS, AND INTERNATIONAL ORDERS EXCEPT CANADA are non-returnable.
If an item is returned with MAKEUP, SELF-TANNER, DEODORANT, PET HAIR, OR STAINS, it will be processed for STORE CREDIT ONLY; the same applies to FINAL-SALE ITEMS. Once your return is received and inspected, your refund is issued to the ORIGINAL PAYMENT METHOD WITHIN 10 BUSINE…
